DuckDB's CLI has colorful output with box-drawing tables:

```yaml
extensions:
  term:
    shell: duckdb
    shell-args: ["-no-init"]
    prompt: "D"
```

## Basic Queries

```{term}
SELECT 'Hello from DuckDB ' || version() AS greeting;
SELECT unnest(range(1, 6)) AS n, unnest(range(1, 6)) * unnest(range(1, 6)) AS square;
```

## Creating Tables

```{term}
CREATE TABLE sales AS SELECT date '2024-01-01' + INTERVAL (i) DAY AS date, ['Widget','Gadget','Doohickey'][1 + (i % 3)] AS product, (random() * 100)::INTEGER AS quantity FROM range(10) t(i);
SELECT * FROM sales LIMIT 5;
```

## Aggregation

```{term}
SELECT product, SUM(quantity) AS total, AVG(quantity)::INTEGER AS avg_qty FROM sales GROUP BY product ORDER BY total DESC;
```

## Built-in Functions

```{term}
SELECT [x*x FOR x IN [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]] AS squares;
SELECT strftime(CURRENT_DATE, '%A, %B %d, %Y') AS today;
```
